name: New Year’s Eve
title: New Year’s Eve at Kismet
metaDescription: New Year’s Eve at Kismet on Main Street in Vancouver, Washington: five courses from Chef Eric on Thursday, December 31, in two seatings. $135 per guest plus tax, paid when you book.
lede: Five courses from Chef Eric for the last night of the year, served in two seatings.
priceNote: per guest, plus tax, paid when you book
tableNote: Wine, other drinks and gratuity are paid at the table.
seatingNote: Dinner takes about two hours, and we hold each table for two hours.

notes.title: Paying
notes.text: $135 per guest, plus tax, is paid when you book. Wine, other drinks and gratuity are paid at the table.

notes.title: Change of plans
notes.text: Cancel at least 72 hours before your reservation for a full refund. After that we can’t refund, but you can give your table to someone else: email hello@kismetvancouver.com with their name by December 30.

notes.title: Allergies and dietary needs
notes.text: The menu is set, one dish for each course. Tell us when you book, and please call ahead about serious allergies. Some changes are possible and some aren’t; we can’t create separate dishes or custom menus.

notes.title: Over the holidays
notes.text: We’re closed Friday, December 25 through Monday, December 28, and Friday, January 1 through Thursday, January 7. We’re back Friday, January 8 at 5 pm.

home.title: Five courses for the last night of the year.
home.text: Two seatings, from 4:30 pm and from 7 pm. $135 per guest plus tax, paid when you book.
